Calculate the current required in the exciting coil to produce a flux of $4\ \mathrm{mWb}$ in the ring. Assume the relative permeability of iron at this flux density as 800. Neglect any leakage or fringing of the magnetic field.

questions.markdown:
A load of 2 kW operates at 0.8 lagging power factor when connected to a 240 V, 1-phase, 50 Hz source. Find

i) Current in the load and power factor angle.
ii) Impedance, resistance, and reactance of the load.

For the circuit shown below, calculate the:

i) Total admittance, total conductance, and total susceptance.
ii) Total current and power factor.
iii) The value of the pure capacitance to be connected in parallel with the above combination to make the total power factor unity.

questions.markdown: A series R-L-C circuit has the following parameter values $R = 10\ \Omega$, $L = 0.01\ \mathrm{H}$, $C = 100\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Compute the resonant frequency, bandwidth, and lower and upper half power frequencies.

A 1-phase motor takes 15 A at a power factor of 0.6 lagging from a 230 V, 50 Hz supply. Determine (i) the capacitance of the capacitor, and the current taken by it, connected in parallel with the motor to correct the power factor to 0.8 lagging, and (ii) the value of the supply current after power factor correction.

Three loads: $Z_{RY} = (50 + j\,40)\ \Omega$, $Z_{YB} = 100\ \Omega$ and $Z_{BR} = (80 - j\,60)\ \Omega$ are connected in delta across a balanced 3-Phase, 415 V, 50 Hz, RYB supply system. Assuming $V_{RY}$ as the reference phasor, determine:

i) Phase currents and circulating current in the delta.
ii) Line currents and phasor sum of line currents.

The 3-phase star connected balanced load has an impedance of $Z = (8 + j6)\ \Omega$ per phase. If the load is connected to 3-phase, 208 V supply and two-wattmeter method is used to measure the power, find the readings of the wattmeters and load power factor using wattmeter readings. Also find the total active, reactive, and apparent power.
Discuss the function and utility of an electrical substation. List out the major substation components.
Explain the operation of a transformer. Obtain the expressions for primary and secondary induced EMF in a transformer.
